author: Mark Atwood
text: Coordination: design for the signature-coverage fix landed on project-LICHEN-worker6-nwjl (comment D1-D6). COSE_Sign1 envelope makes has_signature structurally redundant — do NOT add setters; the 4th COSE array element is the signature. nwjl.3 supersedes the decode-gap part of this bead (COSE-aware decode_claim) and includes the WARN rate-limited logging ask; nwjl.6 covers closure evidence. Recommend resolving this bead as superseded-by nwjl.3 when that lands.
